purpose: Patient can view the static weekly doctor schedule together with current-day real-time attendance status.
preconditions: User authenticated as a patient; a published doctor schedule exists and today's attendance is recorded.
action_or_input: Patient opens Doctor Availability.
expected_result: The published weekly schedule and current-day attendance status are displayed together; no schedule data is changed.

purpose: PHC Staff can maintain the static weekly schedule of visiting doctors.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; a doctor schedule record exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff updates the applicable days and hours for a doctor's weekly schedule.
expected_result: The doctor master schedule is updated; previous schedule remains unchanged if data is invalid.

purpose: PHC Staff can mark a visiting doctor Available or Departed in real time.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; the doctor's current-day attendance record exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks the doctor Available (arrival) or Departed (departure).
expected_result: The doctor's current attendance status is updated and saved for patient-facing availability display.

purpose: PHC Staff can create a doctor schedule.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; no schedule exists for the doctor on that day.
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates/configures a doctor schedule with doctor name, day, start and end time.
expected_result: A doctor schedule is created under PHC Staff authorization; not published until explicitly published.

purpose: PHC Staff can publish a doctor schedule for patient visibility.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; an unpublished doctor schedule exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff selects the schedule and publishes it.
expected_result: The published schedule becomes available to patient-facing doctor availability.

purpose: PHC Staff can search for a patient profile.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; patient profiles exist in the system.
action_or_input: PHC Staff searches for a patient by name or ID.
expected_result: Matching patient profiles are returned to authorized PHC Staff.

purpose: PHC Staff can create a patient visit record.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; a patient profile exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates a visit record under the selected patient profile after a consultation.
expected_result: The patient record contains the new visit; incomplete records are not persisted.

purpose: PHC Staff can digitize a physical prescription linked to a patient record.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; a visit record exists for the patient.
action_or_input: PHC Staff enters the physical prescription and links it to the patient/visit record.
expected_result: The prescription is stored under the corresponding patient record.

purpose: Patient has read-only access to their own medical history.
preconditions: User authenticated as a patient; the patient has visit records.
action_or_input: Patient opens My Medical Records.
expected_result: The patient's own medical history is displayed in read-only form; no medical record is modified.

purpose: Patient can access prescriptions associated with their own medical history.
preconditions: User authenticated as a patient; prescriptions are linked to the patient's records.
action_or_input: Patient views their medical history.
expected_result: Prescriptions linked to the authenticated patient's records are displayed.

purpose: Patient can download PDF copies of their own medical records.
preconditions: User authenticated as a patient; selected records belong to the authenticated patient.
action_or_input: Patient requests a PDF download while viewing their records.
expected_result: A PDF copy of the selected record(s) is provided to the patient.

purpose: Access to patient medical data is restricted by role and ownership; patient cannot access another patient's records.
preconditions: User authenticated as a patient; another patient's record exists.
action_or_input: Patient attempts to access another patient's record.
expected_result: Access is denied; no medical record is exposed to an unauthorized user.

purpose: Reimbursement submission is restricted to institute employees; students are excluded.
preconditions: A student user is authenticated; a valid prescription exists for the student.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit a medical bill reimbursement claim.
expected_result: Submission is denied; only eligible employees may submit claims.

purpose: Each reimbursement claim must be linked to a valid prescription already recorded for the claimant.
preconditions: User authenticated as an employee; no valid prescription exists for the employee.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit a claim without a valid recorded prescription link.
expected_result: Submission is denied; the prescription link is validated before accepting the claim.

purpose: The configured reimbursement submission window is enforced against the medical expense date.
preconditions: User authenticated as an employee; valid prescription linked; expense date is outside the submission window.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit a claim with an expense date outside the configured window.
expected_result: Submission is denied; the claim is accepted only when within the configured submission window.

purpose: An eligible employee can submit a medical bill reimbursement claim entering the approval progression.
preconditions: User authenticated as an employee; valid prescription linked; expense date within submission window.
action_or_input: Employee submits a valid claim with claim information and selected prescription.
expected_result: A valid claim is created and placed in Submitted/Pending PHC Review state, routed to PHC Staff.

purpose: A submitted claim moves through PHC review -> A&A verification -> Approving Authority sanction -> A&A payment in order.
preconditions: An eligible employee has submitted a claim in Submitted state.
action_or_input: The claim is advanced through each stage in the defined forward order.
expected_result: The claim progresses sequentially across the stated stages without skipping or reversing.

purpose: PHC Staff can review a submitted claim and forward it to Accounts & Audit.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; claim state is Pending PHC Review.
action_or_input: PHC Staff reviews the claim and forwards it to Accounts & Audit.
expected_result: The PHC review outcome is recorded; the claim is forwarded to Accounts & Audit (Pending Accounts Verification).

purpose: Accounts & Audit can verify the financial details of a reimbursement claim.
preconditions: User authenticated as Accounts & Audit; claim state is Pending Accounts Verification.
action_or_input: Accounts & Audit verifies the claim's financial details.
expected_result: Verification is recorded; on success the claim is forwarded for sanction (Pending Sanction).

purpose: Approving Authority can approve or reject a reimbursement sanction.
preconditions: User authenticated as Approving Authority; claim state is Pending Sanction.
action_or_input: Approving Authority selects Approve or Reject for the verified claim.
expected_result: Approval or rejection is recorded and the claim state is updated accordingly.

purpose: Accounts & Audit can process the final payment for an approved reimbursement claim.
preconditions: User authenticated as Accounts & Audit; claim state is Approved for Payment.
action_or_input: Accounts & Audit processes the final payment.
expected_result: Payment completion is recorded and the claim is closed as Reimbursed.

purpose: Employee can view current status and action history of their submitted reimbursement claims.
preconditions: User authenticated as an employee; the employee has submitted claims.
action_or_input: Employee opens My Reimbursement Claims / reimbursement dashboard.
expected_result: Current workflow stage and recorded action history are displayed for the employee's claims only.

purpose: The claimant is notified when a reimbursement claim status changes, including rejection and payment.
preconditions: A claim status transition occurs (e.g. rejection or payment processing).
action_or_input: A reimbursement claim status changes.
expected_result: A status-change notification is generated for the claimant.

purpose: PHC Staff can add to or deduct from inventory stock levels.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; an inventory item exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff records a stock receipt (add) or consumption (deduct) with a quantity.
expected_result: The selected inventory item's stock level is updated; invalid adjustments are rejected.

purpose: The updated inventory stock level is compared with the item's reorder threshold.
preconditions: An inventory stock level has been updated; the item has a configured reorder threshold.
action_or_input: The system evaluates the stock level against the threshold after an update.
expected_result: The stock level is evaluated against the configured threshold.

purpose: PHC Staff is notified when an inventory item's stock falls below its reorder threshold.
preconditions: An updated stock level is below the item's reorder threshold.
action_or_input: Stock is updated such that it falls below the reorder threshold.
expected_result: A low-stock warning/alert is generated for PHC Staff.

purpose: PHC Staff can create and submit an inventory procurement requisition with required items and quantities.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; inventory items exist.
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates a requisition, adds items/quantities, and submits it.
expected_result: A requisition is created and submitted in Pending Approval state, routed to the Approving Authority.

purpose: A submitted requisition is routed to the Approving Authority for decision.
preconditions: A requisition is in Pending Approval state.
action_or_input: The submitted requisition reaches the Approving Authority.
expected_result: The requisition is routed to the Approving Authority for decision.

purpose: Approving Authority can approve or reject a pending inventory requisition.
preconditions: User authenticated as Approving Authority; requisition state is Pending Approval.
action_or_input: Approving Authority selects Approve or Reject for the pending requisition.
expected_result: An Approved or Rejected outcome is recorded; the originating PHC Staff is notified.

purpose: The originating PHC Staff member is notified when a requisition is approved or rejected.
preconditions: A requisition becomes Approved or Rejected.
action_or_input: The Approving Authority records a decision on a requisition.
expected_result: A status notification is generated for the requisition originator.

purpose: PHC Staff can mark an approved requisition as Fulfilled after supplies are delivered.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; requisition state is Approved; supplies delivered.
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks the approved requisition Fulfilled.
expected_result: The requisition state becomes Fulfilled and the workflow is closed; fulfillment does not auto-post stock.

purpose: PHC Staff can record ambulance usage with timestamp, patient name, and destination.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; the PHC ambulance is used.
action_or_input: PHC Staff records timestamp, patient name, and destination for the ambulance use.
expected_result: The ambulance usage is recorded with all required fields; incomplete entries are not persisted.

purpose: PHC Staff can publish health advisories visible to all patients on their dashboards.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; health advisory content exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff publishes a health advisory.
expected_result: The health advisory is visible to all patients on their dashboards.

purpose: PHC Staff can generate administrative reports on patient demographics, service utilization, and inventory consumption.
preconditions: User authenticated as PHC Staff; PHC data exists.
action_or_input: PHC Staff requests an administrative report with a category and parameters.
expected_result: A report is generated from PHC data for the selected category.

purpose: Report output is anonymized and patient-identifiable information is protected.
preconditions: A report containing patient-derived data is generated.
action_or_input: PHC Staff generates a report with patient-derived data.
expected_result: No patient-identifiable information appears in the report output.

purpose: Access to every PHC function is restricted according to the authenticated user's assigned role.
preconditions: A user attempts to access a PHC function without the required role.
action_or_input: A user attempts to access a PHC function.
expected_result: Access is authorized or denied based on the user's assigned role.

purpose: An immutable audit trail records successful actions creating/modifying/deleting sensitive patient records, inventory levels, or reimbursement-claim status.
preconditions: A covered sensitive-data action succeeds (e.g. claim status change, inventory adjustment).
action_or_input: A sensitive-data change action is performed.
expected_result: An immutable audit record is appended for the action.

purpose: Any post-submission change or post-rejection resubmission is made as a new claim, not by modifying or reopening the existing claim.
preconditions: A claim is submitted or rejected; the employee needs to change it or claim again.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to change a submitted claim or reapply after rejection.
expected_result: The existing claim and its history are preserved; a separate new reimbursement claim is required.
